versions.changelog:
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.
- Updated references and documentation files for clarity and completeness.
- Improved and clarified confirmation protocol and parameter confirmation requirements in SKILL.md.
- No changes to core Python scripts functionality; all updates are documentation and reference-oriented.

Alibaba Cloud AgentLoop Evaluation skill initial release.

- Enables orchestration of AgentLoop evaluation workflows via the Aliyun CLI plugin, including safe preview before execution.
- Supports creation, update, and management of evaluators and evaluator skills.
- Allows one-shot sample tests, trace and batch (dataset) runs, polling, and result inspection.
- Provides tools for analyzing evaluation quality, diagnosing low scores, and troubleshooting evaluation API calls.
- Enforces explicit user confirmation for any cloud resource mutations, with a required dry-run/preview and three-step confirmation protocol.
